ADDENDUM <No. 21426, April 20, 2009>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Assistants to Military Attachés) A person appointed as an assistant to a military attaché under the former provisions shall be deemed appointed as an assistant military attaché under the amended provisions of Article 6 (2) upon this Decree's entry into force.

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning the Authorized Number of Military Attachés)
(1) The 24 military attachés (including assistants to military attachés; hereinafter the same shall apply) exceeding the authorized number specified in the attached Table when this Decree enters into force shall be deemed to have corresponding additional authorized positions at diplomatic missions abroad from the enforcement date of this Decree until their respective terms expire under paragraph (2).
(2) Among the military attachés referred to in paragraph (1), the term of a person who assumed office in 2006 shall expire on July 31, 2009; of a person who assumed office in 2007, on December 31, 2009; and of a person who assumed office in 2008, on July 31, 2010: Provided, That the term of the assistant to the military attaché stationed in Iraq shall expire on December 31, 2009.
